title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature allows yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling support for a wider range of APIs and improving overall framework usability. It will include automatic detection of request body type and parsing into a JavaScript object. This enhancement is crucial for building robust and versatile APIs
acceptance: Request body parsing works correctly for JSON and URL-encoded data, and errors are properly handled and logged
reason: Enhancing request body parsing capabilities is essential for a production-ready framework like yantraverse, as it directly impacts the framework's ability to handle various API use cases and provides a better developer experience
